construction.method: Manual pinned-source distillation informed by the existing Repo-To-Skill ledger; no AREX/DisCo execution or behavioral efficacy claim.

applicability.scope: MiniMax-H3 joint audio/video C/Metal runtime audit: raw checkpoint compatibility, input encoders, schedule precompute, phased/cached residency, numerical controls and SSD streaming on Apple Silicon. Common catalog placement is a discovery classification, not cross-backend qualification.
applicability.prerequisites: Access to the pinned source architecture and selected component/format inventory; native checks need matching model, fixture and backend resources within an authorized experiment budget.
applicability.input_contract: Runtime revision/patches, macOS/SDK/GPU and memory budget, FL2VA/Ref2VA selection, component formats, prompt and ordered media, requested/aligned frames, canvases, steps/seed, layer/reuse/token/precision policies and preview/interactive-cache state.
applicability.produced_artifact: A phase/component/owner ledger with resident weights, runtime/host buffers, overlap, release/reuse boundaries and observations/unknowns, followed by a discriminating check, actual result and remaining gap.
applicability.failure_modes: Estimating fit from model-file bytes, confusing runtime int8 with incompatible MLX bundles, ignoring preview/cache overlap, or reducing DiT residency to address a VAE/host-output peak can produce a wrong capacity diagnosis.
applicability.refusal_point: Stop at unavailable model/fixture/backend resources or the accepted experiment budget; missing target evidence remains unverified/INCONCLUSIVE.

limitations: Native h3.c/Metal execution, target peak memory, audio/video quality, performance, service behavior and skill efficacy were not run.
Only the bounded readset was inspected; complete kernel, driver/MPSGraph, tokenizer, FFmpeg, concurrent-caller and failure-path coverage is not established.
The retained inventory authenticates only prior JSON header observations, not weight payloads; full official versus selected truncated/packed export inventories are distinct.
Upstream 128 GB M5 Max results and tracked DiT bytes do not qualify a 64 GiB target, a different workload or total physical memory.
MIT covers the h3.c source; retained BSD-3-Clause notices and independent model/export/tool licenses remain separate. UNKNOWN source-license fields are unresolved.
recommendations: Resolve the actual conditioning and output components before counting residency; do not add alternative checkpoints or count shared files twice.
Trace one-shot, preview and interactive ownership separately, including AdaLN schedule dependencies and prepared-cache reset boundaries.
Classify approximation and precision controls before comparison, then measure the relevant phase with tensor, physical/compressed/swap and storage observations.
